updateMessage: Rebased onto upstream Technitium DNS Server 15.6.1. Includes the upstream LDAP auth fixes (StartTLS/LDAPS on Linux), the block list config-transfer and lazy-save changes, the CNAME negative cache fix, and the NOTIFY/IXFR interop fixes. Fork DNS config version remains 8: the upstream v7 layout plus the fork DoH custom landing page, with the existing probe migrating older config files automatically.
